sentences.s: Up until a few decades ago, our visions of the future were largely—though by no means uniformly—glowingly positive.

trunk.主干翻译: 我们对未来的设想是灿烂乐观的。

components.原文: Up until a few decades ago
components.中文翻译: 直到几十年前
components.说明: 时间状语，限定主句所述情形的时间范围。

components.原文: though by no means uniformly
components.中文翻译: 尽管绝非千篇一律
components.说明: 破折号间的让步性插入语，对largely加以补充限定。

sentences.zh: 直到几十年前，我们对未来的设想在很大程度上——尽管绝非千篇一律——还是灿烂乐观的。

sentences.s: Science and technology would cure all the ills of humanity, leading to lives of fulfilment and opportunity for all.

trunk.主干翻译: 科学技术将治愈人类所有的弊病。

components.原文: leading to lives of fulfilment and opportunity for all
components.中文翻译: 从而带来人人都能充实而充满机遇的生活
components.说明: 现在分词短语作结果状语，表示主句动作带来的结果。

sentences.zh: 科学技术将治愈人类所有的弊病，从而让所有人都能过上充实且充满机遇的生活。

sentences.s: Now utopia has grown unfashionable, as we have gained a deeper appreciation of the range of threats facing us, from asteroid strike to epidemic flu and to climate change.

trunk.主干翻译: 如今乌托邦已经过时了。

components.原文: as we have gained a deeper appreciation of the range of threats facing us, from asteroid strike to epidemic flu and to climate change
components.中文翻译: 因为我们更深刻地认识到了面临的种种威胁——从小行星撞击到流感疫情再到气候变化
components.说明: as引导原因状语从句，解释乌托邦过时的缘由。

components.原文: facing us
components.中文翻译: 我们所面临的
components.说明: 现在分词短语作后置定语，修饰threats。

sentences.zh: 如今乌托邦已经过时了，因为我们更深刻地认识到了我们所面临的种种威胁——从小行星撞击到流感疫情，再到气候变化。

sentences.s: You might even be tempted to assume that humanity has little future to look forward to.

trunk.主干翻译: 你甚至可能会忍不住认为……

components.原文: to assume that humanity has little future to look forward to
components.中文翻译: 去认为人类没有什么未来可以期待
components.说明: 不定式作be tempted的补足成分，承接被动结构。

components.原文: that humanity has little future to look forward to
components.中文翻译: 人类没有什么值得期待的未来
components.说明: that引导assume的宾语从句。

components.原文: to look forward to
components.中文翻译: 可供期待的
components.说明: 不定式作后置定语修饰future（此处依k提示按定语处理）。

sentences.zh: 你甚至可能会忍不住认为，人类没有什么值得期待的未来。

trunk.主干翻译: 这种悲观情绪是错位的。

sentences.zh: 但这种悲观情绪是没有道理的。

sentences.s: The fossil record shows that many species have endured for millions of years—so why shouldn't we?

components.原文: that many species have endured for millions of years
components.中文翻译: 许多物种已经存续了数百万年
components.说明: that引导shows的宾语从句。

sentences.zh: 化石记录表明，许多物种已经存续了数百万年——那么我们为什么不能呢？

sentences.s: Take a broader look at our species' place in the universe, and it becomes clear that we have an excellent chance of surviving for tens, if not hundreds, of thousands of years.

components.原文: Take a broader look at our species' place in the universe, and it becomes clear
components.中文翻译: 更广阔地审视我们这一物种在宇宙中的位置，就会清楚地看到
components.说明: 祈使句+and构成的并列结构，相当于条件关系（若……，就……）。

components.原文: that we have an excellent chance of surviving for tens, if not hundreds, of thousands of years
components.中文翻译: 我们极有可能存续数万年乃至数十万年
components.说明: that从句为it所指代的真正主语（形式主语it）。

sentences.zh: 更广阔地审视我们这一物种在宇宙中的位置，就会清楚地看到：我们极有可能存续数万年，乃至数十万年。

sentences.s: Look up Homo sapiens in the "Red List" of threatened species of the international Union for the Conservation of Nature (IUCN), and you will read: "Listed as Least Concern as the species is very widely distributed, adaptable, currently increasing, and there are no major threats resulting in an overall population decline."

components.原文: Look up Homo sapiens in the "Red List" of threatened species of the international Union for the Conservation of Nature (IUCN), and you will read
components.中文翻译: 在国际自然保护联盟（IUCN）的濒危物种“红色名录”中查阅智人，你就会读到
components.说明: 祈使句+and的并列结构，表条件结果关系。

components.原文: (IUCN)
components.中文翻译: （国际自然保护联盟）
components.说明: 缩写作前面机构名称的同位语。

components.原文: Listed as Least Concern as the species is very widely distributed, adaptable, currently increasing, and there are no major threats resulting in an overall population decline
components.中文翻译: 被列为“无危”，因为该物种分布极广、适应力强、目前数量正在增长，且不存在导致整体种群数量下降的重大威胁
components.说明: 引号内整体作read的宾语内容（依k按宾语从句处理）。

components.原文: there are no major threats resulting in an overall population decline
components.中文翻译: 不存在导致整体种群数量下降的重大威胁
components.说明: 与前述as从句中的形容词并列的分句，由and连接。

components.原文: resulting in an overall population decline
components.中文翻译: 导致整体种群数量下降的
components.说明: 现在分词短语作后置定语，修饰threats。

sentences.zh: 在国际自然保护联盟（IUCN）的濒危物种“红色名录”中查阅智人，你会读到：“被列为‘无危’，因为该物种分布极广、适应力强、目前数量正在增长，且不存在导致整体种群数量下降的重大威胁。”

sentences.s: So what does our deep future hold?

trunk.主干翻译: 我们遥远的未来会带来什么？

sentences.zh: 那么，我们遥远的未来会是怎样的呢？

sentences.s: A growing number of researchers and organisations are now thinking seriously about that question.

trunk.主语: A growing number of researchers and organisations
trunk.主干翻译: 越来越多的研究者和机构正在思考那个问题。

components.原文: about that question
components.中文翻译: 关于那个问题
components.说明: 介词短语作状语，说明思考的对象。

sentences.zh: 如今，越来越多的研究者和机构正在认真思考那个问题。

sentences.s: For example, the Long Now Foundation has as its flagship project a mechanical clock that is designed to still be marking time thousands of years hence.

trunk.主干翻译: “今与未来基金会”拥有一座机械钟。

components.原文: as its flagship project
components.中文翻译: 作为其旗舰项目
components.说明: 介词短语作状语（宾语补足成分），说明clock的身份。

components.原文: that is designed to still be marking time thousands of years hence
components.中文翻译: 其设计目标是在数千年后仍能计时
components.说明: that引导的定语从句，修饰clock。

components.原文: to still be marking time thousands of years hence
components.中文翻译: 在数千年后仍然计时
components.说明: 不定式作be designed的补足成分，表设计目的。

sentences.zh: 例如，“今与未来基金会”的旗舰项目是一座机械钟，其设计目标是在数千年之后仍能继续计时。

sentences.s: Perhaps willfully, it may be easier to think about such lengthy timescales than about the more immediate future.

components.原文: Perhaps willfully
components.中文翻译: 或许是有意为之
components.说明: 句首插入语，对全句作评注性补充。

components.原文: to think about such lengthy timescales than about the more immediate future
components.中文翻译: 去思考这样漫长的时间尺度，而非更近的将来
components.说明: 不定式作真正主语（it为形式主语），并含than引出的比较对象。

sentences.zh: 或许是有意为之，思考这样漫长的时间尺度，可能比思考更近的未来更容易。

sentences.s: The potential evolution of today's technology, and its social consequences, is dazzlingly complicated, and it's perhaps best left to science fiction writers and futurologists to explore the many possibilities we can envisage.

trunk.主语: The potential evolution of today's technology
trunk.主干翻译: 当今技术的潜在演变令人眼花缭乱地复杂。

components.原文: and its social consequences
components.修饰对象: The potential evolution of today's technology
components.中文翻译: 及其社会后果
components.说明: and 连接的并列主语成分，与 The potential evolution 共作主语。

components.原文: and it's perhaps best left to science fiction writers and futurologists
components.修饰对象: The potential evolution of today's technology is dazzlingly complicated
components.中文翻译: 也许最好留给科幻作家和未来学家
components.说明: and 连接的并列分句，it 为形式主语，真正主语为后面的不定式。

components.原文: to explore the many possibilities we can envisage
components.修饰对象: it's perhaps best left to science fiction writers and futurologists
components.中文翻译: 去探索我们能设想的诸多可能性
components.说明: 动词不定式作真正主语，由形式主语 it 替代。

components.原文: we can envisage
components.中文翻译: 我们能设想的
components.说明: 省略关系代词 that/which 的定语从句，修饰 the many possibilities。

sentences.zh: 当今技术的潜在演变及其社会后果令人眼花缭乱地复杂，也许最好留给科幻作家和未来学家去探索我们能设想的诸多可能性。

sentences.s: That's one reason why we have launched Arc, a new publication dedicated to the near future.

components.原文: why we have launched Arc, a new publication dedicated to the near future
components.中文翻译: 我们为何创办了Arc——一份专注于近期未来的新刊物
components.说明: why引导的定语从句，修饰reason。

components.原文: a new publication dedicated to the near future
components.中文翻译: 一份专注于近期未来的新刊物
components.说明: 名词短语作Arc的同位语。

components.原文: dedicated to the near future
components.中文翻译: 专注于近期未来的
components.说明: 过去分词短语作后置定语，修饰publication。

sentences.zh: 这正是我们创办Arc——一份专注于近期未来的新刊物——的原因之一。

sentences.s: But take a longer view and there is a surprising amount that we can say with considerable assurance.

components.原文: take a longer view and there is a surprising amount
components.中文翻译: 把眼光放长远，就会有数量惊人的（内容）
components.说明: 祈使句+and的并列结构，表条件结果关系。

components.原文: that we can say with considerable assurance
components.中文翻译: 我们可以相当有把握地说出的
components.说明: that引导的定语从句，修饰amount。

sentences.zh: 但只要把眼光放长远，就会有数量惊人的内容是我们可以相当有把握地说出来的。

sentences.s: As so often, the past holds the key to the future: we have now identified enough of the long-term patterns shaping the history of the planet, and our species, to make evidence-based forecasts about the situations in which our descendants will find themselves.

trunk.主干翻译: 过去掌握着通向未来的钥匙。

components.原文: As so often
components.中文翻译: 正如常常发生的那样
components.说明: As引导方式状语从句（省略结构），评注后文情形之常见。

components.原文: shaping the history of the planet, and our species
components.中文翻译: 塑造这颗星球以及我们这一物种历史的
components.说明: 现在分词短语作后置定语，修饰patterns。

components.原文: to make evidence-based forecasts about the situations in which our descendants will find themselves
components.中文翻译: 以便对我们后代将身处的境况作出基于证据的预测
components.说明: 不定式与enough构成enough...to结构，表结果/目的。

components.原文: in which our descendants will find themselves
components.中文翻译: 我们的后代将身处其中的
components.说明: in which引导的定语从句，修饰situations。

sentences.zh: 正如常常发生的那样，过去掌握着通向未来的钥匙：我们如今已辨识出足够多塑造这颗星球及我们这一物种历史的长期模式，足以对我们后代将身处的境况作出基于证据的预测。

sentences.s: This long perspective makes the pessimistic view of our prospects seem more likely to be a passing fad.

trunk.主干翻译: 这种长远视角使悲观看法显得……

components.原文: the pessimistic view of our prospects seem more likely to be a passing fad
components.中文翻译: 对我们前景的悲观看法更像是一阵短暂的流行
components.说明: make后的复合宾语结构（宾语+seem不带to的补足，依k按宾语处理）。

components.原文: to be a passing fad
components.中文翻译: 成为一阵短暂的流行
components.说明: 不定式作likely的补足成分。

sentences.zh: 这种长远视角使得对我们前景的悲观看法，更像是一阵转瞬即逝的风潮。

sentences.s: To be sure, the future is not all rosy.

components.原文: To be sure
components.中文翻译: 诚然
components.说明: 不定式短语作评注性状语（独立成分）。

sentences.zh: 诚然，未来并非一片光明。

sentences.s: But we are now knowledgeable enough to reduce many of the risks that threatened the existence of earlier humans, and to improve the lot of those to come.

trunk.主干翻译: 我们如今已经足够有知识。

components.原文: to reduce many of the risks that threatened the existence of earlier humans, and to improve the lot of those to come
components.中文翻译: 足以减少许多曾威胁早期人类生存的风险，并改善后人的境遇
components.说明: 与enough构成enough...to结构，表程度结果。

components.原文: that threatened the existence of earlier humans
components.中文翻译: 曾威胁早期人类生存的
components.说明: that引导的定语从句，修饰risks。

components.原文: and to improve the lot of those to come
components.中文翻译: 并改善后人的境遇
components.说明: 与前一不定式并列的第二个不定式，由and连接。

components.原文: to come
components.中文翻译: 将要到来的
components.说明: 不定式作后置定语，修饰those（依k按定语处理）。

sentences.zh: 但如今我们已经掌握了足够的知识，足以减少许多曾威胁早期人类生存的风险，并改善后人的境遇。
